Architecture & Process

Why Grieving Families Wait Months — And How ClaimX Solves It

Traditional insurance claims rely on postal mail, notarized paper forms, and slow paper checks. ClaimX replaces manual bottlenecks with digital registries and instant bank rails.

Legacy Insurance Process 60 – 90 Days Average
  • Must order 10–15 physical certified death certificates ($25 each) and wait 3 weeks.
  • Must locate paper policy documents in locked safes or filing cabinets.
  • Carriers hold funds during 6-week contestability audits while families struggle with funeral costs.
  • Payout delivered via paper check in the snail mail, subject to fraud and bank hold periods.
ClaimX Fast-Track Pipeline Under 48 Hours • RTP
  • Instant Digital EDRS Query: Direct API connection to state health bureaus verifies death in seconds.
  • Automated Policy Clearinghouse: Discovers group policies and lost personal coverage using SSN matching.
  • Instant Funeral Advance: Get $10,000 within 2 hours sent straight to the mortuary or debit card.
  • FedNow / RTP Real-Time Deposit: Funds land immediately with zero clearing delays.

1. State EDRS Network

We interface directly with electronic vital registry databases across 50 states, ensuring tamper-proof legal death validation without physical courier delays.

2. Forensic AI OCR

Audits contestability thresholds, verifies holographic seals, and generates pre-filled standardized NAIC carrier claim packets instantly.

3. FedNow RTP Rail

Liquidity is dispatched through the Federal Reserve’s 24/7/365 real-time clearing rails, allowing instant card push and funeral home direct settlement.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything You Need to Know

Clear, empathetic answers during a difficult time.

You do not need the original policy documents. ClaimX is connected to the National Life Insurance Clearinghouse and MIB Group databases. By providing the deceased's full legal name, date of birth, and Social Security Number, our automated discovery engine scans across 420+ carriers and employer group benefit systems to uncover active policies.
Funeral homes typically demand full upfront payment before embalming, cremation, or casket delivery. If you select Option B in our wizard, ClaimX immediately advances $10,000 (or up to 80% of verified benefits) directly to your debit card or the mortuary within 2 hours. When the carrier clears the total settlement, ClaimX simply disburses the remaining balance (e.g. $290,000) straight to your account.
Yes. ClaimX uses bank-grade 256-bit AES encryption, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and adheres strictly to HIPAA privacy standards for vital medical records. Our digital death verification connects directly with state health departments through standardized Electronic Death Registration System (EDRS) interfaces approved by the National Center for Health Statistics.
Most life insurance policies include a 2-year contestability clause. If a policy was issued more than 2 years prior to death (as shown in our demo for Eleanor Vance, issued in 2017), state insurance law forbids carriers from challenging or denying claims based on pre-existing medical questions. ClaimX automated OCR checks policy issue dates against death dates to certify non-contestability immediately.
ClaimX Standard Settlement is 100% free to beneficiaries. Insurance carriers and employer benefit trusts compensate ClaimX for digital intake processing, as it eliminates hundreds of dollars in paper claim handling costs on their end.
